"""Main: CPU mapping fixtures and exact offline pristine admission preparation."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-long-controller-source-v1'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('admission_prepare_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')
def pin(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path))

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-admission-prepare-root-v5'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_launch_attempted=False, controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__),
             whole_wall_seconds=360)
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    start = time.monotonic()
    def run(label, argv, cwd=P):
        remaining = 360 - (time.monotonic() - start)
        assert remaining > 0
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, ENV, cwd, wall=min(120, remaining), cpu=180,
            rss_cap=4 << 30, text_cap=16 << 20, file_cap=16 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        m.require(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label)
        return so.read_text()
    try:
        text = run('mapping-fixtures', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B',
                   str(B / 'latest-update-main-mapping-cpu-fixtures-v2.py'), str(out / 'mapping-fixtures')])
        r['mapping_fixtures'] = json.loads(text)
        assert r['mapping_fixtures']['passed']
        template = P / 'qualification-long.pending.json'
        q = json.loads(template.read_text())
        cpu_path = B / 'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v8/record.json'
        cpu = json.loads(cpu_path.read_text())
        assert cpu['passed'] and cpu['complete'] and not cpu['active']
        libraries_path = B / 'latest-update-main-runtime-pins-root-v2/record.json'
        libraries = json.loads(libraries_path.read_text())
        assert libraries['passed'] and libraries['complete'] and not libraries['active']
        review = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True, gpu_executed=False,
            controller_source_pins=q['controller_source_pins'], model_launch_attempted=False,
            source_review='Main read prior seven-file controller and authored/reviewed official-only long controller: sufficient affinity-scaled CPU,3600s wall, bounded progress and supportedSTOP90s grace;23parsernegatives+ownedmock+pendingprocessPASS',
            actual_cpu_receipt=pin(cpu_path), mapping_fixture_result=r['mapping_fixtures'],
            retained_identity_checks=['exact SHA/stat/inode, actual owned PID/exe/argv/env, optional ELF build-ID explicitly null when absent',
                'only own native V2 provider; matching installed UMF dependency path',
                'source-format device regex plus actual qualified device name; observed metrics retained',
                'R218 incremental strict stderr scan and partial enum fixtures',
                'fresh normal health, no reset/retry, strict protocol, normal QUIT and empty anchored session'],
            limitations=['no model inference/fit/performance/full-logit/full262144 runtime claim',
                'pristine ignored event return errors remain a source observability limitation'])
        review_path = out / 'controller-review.json'
        review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, indent=2) + '\n')
        identity_path = B / 'latest-update-main-model-identity-v1.json'
        identity = json.loads(identity_path.read_text())
        manifest = dict(main_reviewed=True, template=pin(template), controller_cpu=pin(cpu_path),
            controller_review=pin(review_path), model_identity_receipt=pin(identity_path),
            model_inputs=identity['model_inputs'], tools={name: pin(Path('/usr/bin') / filename)
                for name, filename in [('git', 'git'), ('journalctl', 'journalctl'), ('systemctl', 'systemctl'), ('python', 'python3')]},
            engines={})
        research = B / 'research-20261009'
        reports = [pin(research / name) for name in [
            'research-pristine-xe0142-prefill-decode-transition-owner-admission-round216-v1.txt',
            'research-official-v0143-selected-native-pack-ple-compatibility-round217-v1.txt',
            'research-pristine-controller-v2-post-ready-diagnostic-gates-round218-v1.txt',
            'research-official-v0143-independent-prefill-decode-parameter-selection-round219-v1.txt']]
        for engine in ('xe', 'official'):
            lib = libraries['engines'][engine]
            health = json.loads(Path(lib['health_receipt']['path']).read_text())
            actual_name = health['device_discovery']['device_name']
            device = re.escape(actual_name)
            pattern = (r"strata generate: GPU " + device + r", [0-9]+ compute units, [0-9]+\.[0-9] GiB, prompt matrix products on XeStrata's own kernels \(.+\)"
                if engine == 'xe' else r'strata generate: GPU 0: ' + device + r', compute capability [0-9]+\.[0-9]+')
            source = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True,
                binary=q['binaries'][engine], source_pins=q['production_source_pins'][engine],
                gpu_executed=False, model_inference_tested=False,
                scope='Source route admission before actual pristine startup; actual metadata/JIT/fit remain runtime gates',
                source_route=('Actual backend=xe top-level source, directly allocated per-layer hostUSM arena, separate in-order copy/compute queues, issuer0, event barriers and segmented verifier'
                              if engine == 'xe' else 'Actual sycl CMake .dp.cpp sources, native preset, mandatory --prefill8 for serve setup; actual read_windows8+short-read65536, stepped verifier+PIPE0+NO_HOST0, final commit queue drain'),
                reviewed_reports=reports, pristine_source_patch_applied=False,
                native_ple_compatibility='Selected native expert type pairs and packed BF16 PLE/F16 conv/F32 norms have source routes; loaders must verify original GGUF/shard metadata at actual startup',
                ignored_intermediate_event_errors_reviewed=engine == 'xe',
                selected_runtime_errors_fatal=True,
                performance_config_optimized=False)
            source_path = out / (engine + '-source-review.json')
            source_path.write_text(json.dumps(source, indent=2) + '\n')
            compiler = (Path(health['environment']['PATH'].split(':')[0]) / ('clang++' if engine == 'xe' else 'icpx'))
            config = {'CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER': str(compiler)}
            if engine == 'xe':
                config.update(STRATA_LICENSE='free', STRATA_ONEMKL='OFF', STRATA_CUDA_ARCHS='')
            manifest['engines'][engine] = dict(lib, health_record=lib['health_receipt'],
                source_route_review=pin(source_path), device_name=actual_name,
                expected_device_stderr_patterns=[pattern], macro_config=config,
                provider_health_reviewed=True, compiler_macro_reviewed=True,
                backend='xe' if engine == 'xe' else 'sycl', strata_enable_sycl=False,
                ignored_intermediate_event_errors_reviewed=engine == 'xe')
        manifest_path = out / 'input-manifest.json'
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
        run('resolve', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', str(B / 'latest-update-pristine-admission-resolver-main-v6.py'),
                       '--manifest', str(manifest_path), '--output', str(out / 'resolved')])
        qualification = out / 'resolved/qualification.json'
        code = "from pathlib import Path;from common import admit,load;from policy import HERE; q=load(Path(__import__('sys').argv[1]));prod=load(HERE/'production-source-pins.json');[admit(q,e,prod) for e in ('xe','official')];print('PASS actual resolved admission for both pristine binaries; no owner import or engine launch')"
        run('actual-both-admission', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', '-c', code, str(qualification)])
        r['qualification'] = pin(qualification)
        r['complete'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error', 'qualification']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
